forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.subtitle: The page was not opened
forbidden.alertTitle: Access was refused because of permissions
forbidden.alertDescription: You do not have the permission this page needs. Nothing was changed. If you need it, contact your system administrator.
forbidden.tip1: Go back to the previous page or ask your system administrator for the right permission. Do not retry before your permissions are updated.

notFound.title: Item not found
notFound.subtitle: The record could not be opened
notFound.alertTitle: The requested record was not found
notFound.alertDescription: The record may not exist, or it may belong to a warehouse outside the ones you are allowed to see.
notFound.tip1: No extra details are shown about warehouses you cannot access. Go back to the list and open one of the available records.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.

unauthorized.title: Sign in required
unauthorized.description: You need to be signed in to view this page. Sign in with your credentials to continue.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.description: You don't have permission to view this page. If you believe this is a mistake, contact an administrator.

serverError.title: Server error
serverError.description: Something went wrong on our end. Please try again in a moment.

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.description: An unexpected error occurred while loading this page.

network.title: No internet connection
network.subtitle: The dashboard can't reach the server right now
network.alertTitle: The connection to the server was lost
network.alertDescription: Your device is offline or the server can't be reached. Nothing you were viewing was changed.
network.tip1: Check your Wi-Fi or network cable and make sure you are online.
network.tip2: If you use a VPN or a proxy, check that it is connected.
network.tip3: The page reloads automatically as soon as the connection is back.
network.online: You're online — the server can't be reached

server.title: The server ran into a problem
server.subtitle: The page data couldn't be loaded
server.alertTitle: The server failed to complete the request
server.alertDescription: This is a problem on the server side, not something you did. Your data was not changed.
server.tip1: Wait a moment and try again — temporary server problems usually clear quickly.
server.tip2: If it keeps happening, send the reference below to your system administrator.

unexpected.title: Something unexpected happened
unexpected.subtitle: The page stopped working because of an unexpected error
unexpected.alertDescription: An unexpected error occurred in the application. The error was recorded so it can be fixed.
unexpected.tip1: Reload the page — most of the time that fixes it.
unexpected.tip2: If it happens again, go back to the dashboard and tell your system administrator what you were doing.
